tidal.vectorfield package#

Vector and tensor field simulation infrastructure.

This package provides utilities for simulating multi-component field systems derived from Lagrangians. It builds on the symbolic package to provide convenient initial condition creation and configuration.

class tidal.vectorfield.ComponentFieldParams(n_components, component_names, spatial_dimension, is_massless=True)[source]#

Bases: object

Parameters for a multi-component field system.

This class encapsulates the field configuration derived from an equation system specification.

Parameters:

  • n_components (int)

  • component_names (tuple[str, ...])

  • spatial_dimension (int)

  • is_massless (bool)

n_components#

Number of field components.

Type:

int

component_names#

Names of the field components (e.g., (“A_0”, “A_1”)).

Type:

tuple[str, …]

spatial_dimension#

Number of spatial dimensions.

Type:

int

is_massless#

Whether all components have zero mass.

Type:

bool

Examples

>>> from tidal.symbolic import load_equation_system
>>> spec = load_equation_system("examples/data/em_1d.json")
>>> params = ComponentFieldParams.from_equation_system(spec)
>>> params.n_components
2

class tidal.vectorfield.ComponentGaussianPulse(center, width, amplitude=1.0, active_components=None)[source]#

Bases: object

Gaussian pulse initial condition for specified field components.

Creates a Gaussian pulse in one or more field components:

field(x) = amplitude * exp(-|x - center|^2 / (2 * width^2))

Parameters:

  • center (tuple[float, ...])

  • width (float)

  • amplitude (float)

  • active_components (dict[str, float] | None)

center#

Center position of the Gaussian in each spatial dimension.

Type:

tuple[float, …]

width#

Width (standard deviation) of the Gaussian.

Type:

float

amplitude#

Peak amplitude of the Gaussian.

Type:

float

active_components#

Mapping from component names to their relative amplitudes. If None, all components get the pulse with amplitude 1.0.

Type:

dict[str, float] | None

Examples

>>> pulse = ComponentGaussianPulse(
...     center=(50.0,),
...     width=5.0,
...     amplitude=1.0,
...     active_components={"A_1": 1.0}
... )
>>> state = pulse.create(grid, spec)
active_components: dict[str, float] | None = None#
amplitude: float = 1.0#

class tidal.vectorfield.ComponentPlaneWave(wavevector, amplitude=1.0, phase=0.0, active_components=None)[source]#

Bases: object

Plane wave initial condition for specified field components.

Creates a plane wave:

field(x) = amplitude * cos(k · x + phase)

With corresponding momentum for a propagating wave:

momentum(x) = -amplitude * omega * sin(k · x + phase)

where omega = |k| for massless fields.

Parameters:

  • wavevector (tuple[float, ...])

  • amplitude (float)

  • phase (float)

  • active_components (dict[str, float] | None)

wavevector#

Wavevector k in each spatial dimension.

Type:

tuple[float, …]

amplitude#

Amplitude of the wave.

Type:

float

phase#

Initial phase in radians.

Type:

float

active_components#

Mapping from component names to their relative amplitudes.

Type:

dict[str, float] | None

Examples

>>> wave = ComponentPlaneWave(
...     wavevector=(0.1,),  # k_x = 0.1
...     amplitude=1.0,
...     phase=0.0,
...     active_components={"A_1": 1.0}
... )
>>> state = wave.create(grid, spec)
active_components: dict[str, float] | None = None#
amplitude: float = 1.0#

tidal.vectorfield.initial_conditions module#

Initial conditions for multi-component field simulations.

This module provides classes and functions for creating initial conditions for field systems derived from Lagrangians.
